projectJoin.title: Come be a part
projectJoin.sub: Nominate yourself on your own terms - you decide what you’ll do or bring, and what it’s worth. Your offer is the opening point of the conversation.
projectJoin.mDescrip: A few details - what exactly, how, why you
projectJoin.perhourHint: Not “what you demand” - what your work is worth. Full-value recording is the basis for fair income sharing, now or later.
projectJoin.rDescrip: A few details about the resource
howSteps: You phrase an offer - a mission you will do or a resource you will bring, on your terms.
The rikma members get it in their Lev: they can approve, chat, or counter - there is no absolute "no".
Once a member engages - silence is consent: with no reply within {restime}, the last offer on the table is approved.
projectJoin.sentBody: The members were notified. Once a member engages, the rikma has {restime} to respond - follow everything in your Lev.
projectJoin.memberBody: Members create missions and resources from the moach - all your tools are there.
projectJoin.guestTitle: You need a (free) account to offer
projectJoin.guestBody: Your offer opens a real conversation with the rikma - that needs an identity. Registration is open and free.
